g.title: Legend
g.text: Black text: attribute present in the Sprint 2 code
Grey italic «target»: only in the base structure
Dashed border: class not yet in the code
Hollow triangle: generalization; filled diamond: composition
In code, UserAccount is concrete and the role is an enum;
the Participant / Organizer / Administrator hierarchy is the target
Ticket: code has orderId + eventSeatId; the target adds orderItemId
